title: trisetum molle subsp. alaskanum
intro: Trisetum molle subsp. alaskanum, commonly known as soft hair grass, is a subspecies of grass native to Alaska and western Canada. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects that can help alleviate various health issues. Research has identified several bioactive constituents in Trisetum molle subsp. alaskanum, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and immune system modulation. The health benefits associated with this plant include reduced inflammation, improved wound healing, and potential antimicrobial properties.
